hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); case "$f" in *.wgsl) d=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"cwd"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); cd "${d:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" && bash scripts/check_shaders.sh "$f" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
